summary: The audit checks the prerequisites (CME 100 or MATH 51, and CS 106A), the five letter-graded core courses, and two more letter-graded MS&E courses numbered 100 or above for at least 3 units each. Checked by hand: if you took a calculus-based probability course such as CS 109 or STATS 118 for your major, you may replace MS&E 120 with another letter-graded MS&E course and move it in. AP and IB credit do not count toward this minor.
